chapter_title: Concerning these Names: God, Rich One, and Angel;

3.original: [in the land of light, and there is no measure to]
3.content: in the land of light, and there is no measure to

spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶3:**
 There
 exist
 three
 infinite
 degrees of life
 within the realm of Divine
 Wisdom,
 and no
 finite
 measure can
 contain
 them.

**¶4:**
 Those
 called
 "
divine
 tru
ths" are
 the primary
 principles
 of truth
 that the
 Divine
 Love
 has
 brought
 forth from
 itself. They are
 formed according to the very
 nature of the
 Divine Love and Wisdom from
 which they proceed.

**¶
5:** Those called "abund
ances
" are the derivative
 goods
 and truths that flow from those
 first
 proce
eding principles. For
 when
 the Divine
 Love
 brought
 forth the primary
 tru
ths, those
 tru
ths in
 turn brought forth further
 truths from
 themselves
,
 and these
 are called
 spiritual
 riches —
 the p
lenitude of good
 and truth in
 desc
ending degree
.

**¶6:** These
 abundant
 derivative
 truths,
 in
 their
 turn, bring
 forth still
 further truths of
 a ministering and medi
ating nature,
 and these are called "
mess
engers."
 These
 are the three degrees of spiritual life within
 the realm of Divine Wisdom.
 They are without limit.

**
¶7:** But
 there
 is
 also
 another
 sense
 in which tru
ths are
 called "divine
":
 those living
 principles
 of
 truth
 that have
 proceeded
 from the Divine Love and
 gone
 forth into spiritual
 combat against falsity and evil, and
 have
 overcome them.

**¶8
:** And
 the
 "
abund
ances" in
 this
 sense are the derivative
 goods
 and truths flowing
 from those first
 living Divine
 truths. They too have
 gone
 forth and accomplished and
 fulfilled the purpose
 of the Divine Love
,
 in both the
 interior and the
 exterior states of the
 human
 spirit
.

**¶10:** Again
, "
divine truths" names
 all
 the principles
 of truth that belong
 to the province
 of the Divine
 Love
 as
 it gov
erns the will
.


**¶11:** And "
mess
engers" names
 all the medi
ating tru
ths that belong to the province of the
 Divine Wisdom as it illumin
ates the understanding.

**¶
12:** And "abund
ances" names all the operative
 goods that
 belong to the province of the Divine Use
 as it acts
 upon
 and
 reforms
 the world.

---


*
Note on
 the structural
 shift
 between
 ¶3
–
6
 and ¶7–12
:
*
 The first
 sequence
 describes
 the three degrees as
 they
 exist in
 eternal
 rest
 within the Divine
 order
 —
 celest
ial, spiritual, natural
,
 proce
eding one
 from another
. The second sequence (
¶7–8
) describes
 those
 same degrees as they go
 forth into active
 combat
 against evil
,
 which
 corresponds
 to the Lord
's work
 of
 redem
ption.
 The
 third sequence (¶10
–12) maps
 the three
 degrees
 onto
 the three fac
ulties of the regener
ating person
:
 will
, understanding, and use
 — the three "
households" of the Divine as
 it
 dw
ells within
 the human form
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: There are these three archetypes [in the land of light, and there is no measure to] them!
So, the ones who are called 'god', are the gods whom the Father has summoned from himself. He has established them after the likeness of his greatness.

Conversely, these who are named 'rich [ones]', are the evocations of the first rich gods of the Father; because, when the Father had summoned (the first), they themselves summoned evocations. They called them 'rich'.
They too, the rich ones, have summoned their evocations. They call them 'angel'. These are the three archetypes who occur in the land of light. There is no measure to apply to them!

Once again, listen! Other persons who are named 'god' are the emanations who have come from the Father; the evocations of the Father whom he summoned forth. They came out to the contest and humiliated the enmity.

Conversely, the 'rich ones' are the evocations of these first living words. They too, the rich ones, have come and performed and fulfilled the pleasure of the greatness, in the worlds that are above and below.
Again, they are called 'god', all the gods who belong to the household of the Great Spirit.
Conversely, the ones who are called 'angel', are all the angels who belong to the household of the Beloved of the Lights.
The ones who are called 'rich', are all the rich ones who belong to the household of the glorious Ambassador.
